claims.statement: Tom Allen had his headquarters at the Buckeye House near Cincinnati while training.
claims.excerpt: the headquarte-s of the above-named gentleman at this time.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was training under his trainer, Sherman Thurston.
claims.excerpt: under the scientitic handling of his experienced trainer, Sherman Thurston,

claims.statement: Tom Allen was training for a forthcoming prize fight; the opponent is not named in this article.
claims.excerpt: is rapidly approaching the splenaid physical condition whien he deems it

fights.excerpt: is rapidly approaching the splenaid physical condition whien he deems it
fights.notes: Opponent not named in this article. Printed as a reprint of the Cincinnati Enquirer of 24 May 1869, so 'yesterday' is 1869-05-23.

notes: Weight is blank in this printing, so the hint's 165 pounds is not supported here and is dropped. Allen's walk and the paper's comments on betting are not included.
